description: I am Phạm Minh Khôi, Hanoi, Vietnam, studying in class 6TA1.1 at Đoàn Thị Điểm Secondary School. I can study coding and model design at an average level, my group is the phoenix, reborn from the ashes, and the star, shining brightly. I promise to lead the group to victory ✌​​
summary: My team developed a game about explore the Mars with another astronaut, players need to answer the question to continue the journey, players have 5 bars:  hunger, water, oxygen, health, spirit. Nowadays, there are many people who don't know much about Mars, so this game can help them learn how to choose the right way to survive in future.
details: Our game is like an adventure on Mars that can provide survival guide to astronauts to help them to travel safely to Mars with only 1 purpose: to turn Mars into a liveable place for human in future. The game was coded by C++ language and we only answer question or choose resources for the astronauts only by mouse. Our team had considered 2 critical factors: easy to play and provides plenty of knowledge about Mars for both students and grown ups.
